name: waypost
description: Self-hosted web analytics: a tiny browser SDK and a Node collector.

scripts.build: npm run build -w waypost-analytics && npm run build -w waypost-backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w waypost-analytics && npm run test -w waypost-backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w waypost-analytics && npm run typecheck -w waypost-backend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w waypost-analytics && npm run dev -w waypost-backend
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w waypost-backend
